name: Aeroports de Paris SA
summary: Aeroports de Paris SA, together with its subsidiaries, operates and designs airports in France, Turkey, Kazakhstan, Jordan, Georgia, and internationally. It operates in five segments: Aviation; Retail and Services; Real Estate; International and Airport Developments; and Other Activities. The Aviation segment offers airport services, such as landing, parking, and passengers; check-in and boarding counters, baggage handling facilities, de-icing facilities, and the supplying of electricity to aircraft; and security and airport safety services, including security checkpoints and screening systems, aircraft rescue, and fire-fighting services.
